note: The hill giants' camp on the West Plateau of Odus, the wild island (no city of the erudites stands on it yet: the words name none). Its people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (West Plateau): Elder Hrolmog, at the foot of the old steps, gives the first two; Stonehand Borrik, beside him, the three hunts; Hidewife Marna, a few steps south-west, is the outfitter; Coachman Durgo keeps the stable on the plain to the south (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes). The plateau skinks (the plain to the west), the rock badgers (the plain to the south) and the old wolf Greyjaw (far to the north, beyond the gatekeeper) are placed for these quests. A giant speaks slow and short. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Stonehand Borrik gives L7-L15, Elder Hrolmog the L20 path; their objectives are on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Durgo's coach), whose Warden Halvek is a hill giant, their kin: badger pelts for Marna, Dunmore's ore with Marna's leather and rime spider silk, Old Frostjaw, the Rimeheart's shard to Halvek, then Halvek's own errand against the raiders.

L1.name: A Young Giant's Tooth
offer: Hmm. A new one. Small yet. You will grow. Everything on the plateau grows, or gets stepped on.
Every giant of the camp wears a rhino's tooth on a thong, so the others know it is no ogre. Hidewife Marna cuts the thongs. She sits a few steps to the south.
Will you fetch your tooth and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then stand there. You are good at it.
L1.started: Marna. A few steps south. Go.

piece.name: young giant's tooth thong
piece.description: A rhino's tooth on a thong of thick hide. Every young giant of the West Plateau camp wears one.

fetch.journal: Ask Hidewife Marna, a few steps south of Elder Hrolmog, for a young giant's tooth thong.
fetch.says: Hrolmog sent you? Bend down. Further. There. A rhino's tooth, and my best hide. Do not chew it. Nothing to pay, little one.

show.journal: Show the young giant's tooth thong to Elder Hrolmog.
show.says: Good tooth. Now the camp knows you. When you are big, you will pull your own from a rhino.

L2.name: A Stone That Comes Back
offer: Giants fall. It is loud, and it hurts. Go to Spiritmaster Ognarr. He will tie your spirit to the camp, so you get up here after.
Then tell Coachman Durgo your name for his ledger. His coach goes to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands. It is a strong coach.
Will you see them both and come back?
L2.started: Ognarr is north. Durgo is south, out on the plain.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Ognarr, north of the elder, bind your spirit to the camp.
bind.says: Done. Fall where you like. You will get up here. Now go and tell Coachman Durgo your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Durgo, on the plain south of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A giant! Good. I built the coach for giants. It runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now you always come back.
Durgo's coach goes where its ledgers know you. But the stone way to Oggok is earned. Stonehand Borrik, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Skinks in the Grass
offer: You are the new one. Good. Skinks are in the grass west of camp. They bite ankles. Giants have a lot of ankle.
Stamp on some. Bring me three of their scales. Then I will show you a thing.
Will you hunt them?
L3.started: Three scales. West, out on the plain.

drop.name: plateau skink scale
drop.description: A scale of a plateau skink from the plain west of the giants' camp.

hunt.journal: Take three plateau skink scales from the plateau skinks on the plain west of the camp.

give.journal: Bring three plateau skink scales to Stonehand Borrik.
give.says: Three scales. Ankles still on. Good. Now watch my hands, and learn this.

L4.name: A Young Giant's Arms
offer: Fists are good. Fists with something in them are better. I will make you proper gear. You fetch what I need.
Hidewife Marna has leather and a shaft for me. Then take a claw off the rock badgers on the plain south of camp.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then use your fists. They are not bad.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Marna. A claw from the badgers. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Hidewife Marna for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Borrik? Here. Hide, and a shaft. It was a tree this morning. Tell him to make it a big one.

drop.name: rock badger claw
drop.description: The claw of a rock badger from the plain south of the giants' camp.

hunt.journal: Take a rock badger claw from the rock badgers on the plain south of the camp.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the rock badger claw to Stonehand Borrik.
give.says: All three. Stand back. This is loud... there. It is yours. Do not drop it on anyone you like.

L5.name: Old Greyjaw
offer: One more thing. An old wolf, Greyjaw, hunts far to the north, past Thundrik's stones. It took a calf from the herders. It is not afraid of giants.
It will come at you first. Let it. Then hit it. Bring me its fang.
Will you hunt Greyjaw?
L5.declined: It is old. It is not getting slower.
L5.started: North. Past Thundrik and his stones, and on. It will find you.

drop.name: Greyjaw's fang
drop.description: A yellowed fang of the old wolf Greyjaw of the West Plateau.

hunt.journal: Take Greyjaw's fang from the old wolf Greyjaw, far north of the camp, beyond the gatekeeper.

give.journal: Bring Greyjaw's fang to Stonehand Borrik.
says: Greyjaw's fang. Hah! The herders will sleep. You are not so small now.
Learn this. Then see Gatekeeper Thundrik at the stones to the north when you want Oggok.

flight.name: The Stone Way
offer: The ogres of Oggok are strong, and they like giants. They will train you as one of their own, across the sea.
You have earned the stone way. I will set you down among your own guild in Oggok, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I open the way to Oggok?
flight.declined: The way will keep. Stone does.
flight.started: Stand still and hold your breath. Walk tall in Oggok!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thundrik when you are ready to go to Oggok.

L7.name: Pelts for Marna
offer: You are bigger now. Good. Marna wants pelts for the cold months. Our plateau has no snow. The Goldfeather Eyrie has lots.
Ride Durgo's coach to the Eyrie outpost. Badgers live on the snow east of it. Bring me three pelts.
Will you hunt badgers for Marna?
L7.declined: Then Marna is cold. She will tell you about it.
L7.started: Three pelts. Not torn. Marna is fussy.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take three snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the three snowfield badger pelts to Stonehand Borrik.
give.says: Three. Good thick ones. Marna will stop shouting. Now watch my hands, and learn this.

L10.name: A Bigger Thing to Hit With
offer: You grew. Your arms did not. I will make you a bigger thing to hit with.
The quartermaster at the Eyrie outpost has ore. Marna has leather. Then bring one skein of silk off the rime spiders north-east of the outpost, to wrap the grip.
Will you bring me ore, leather and silk?
L10.declined: Then hit things with the small one.
L10.started: Ore, leather, silk. Three things. Count on your fingers.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore Borrik wants.
materials.says: Borrik's? He sent word by the coach: "big ore." Here, the biggest I have. Mind your feet when you carry it.

materials.journal: Ask Hidewife Marna for a leather strip.
materials.says: For Borrik's grip? Here. Badger leather, from your pelts. See? Nothing wasted.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take a skein of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the iron ore, the leather strip and the rime spider silk to Stonehand Borrik.
give.says: All three. Stand back. This is louder than last time... there. It is yours. It is big. Good.

L13.name: Frostjaw
offer: Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost is a giant. Our blood. He sent word. An old snow leopard, Frostjaw, eats his hunters on the slopes north-east of the outpost.
Halvek cannot leave the outpost. You can. Kill Frostjaw. Take friends. Leopards are fast. Giants are not.
Will you kill Old Frostjaw?
L13.started: Hit him hard. Then hit him again.

hunt.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Frostjaw is dead? Hah! Halvek will drink to you. So will I. Learn this.

L15.name: Ice for Halvek
offer: Halvek sent word again. Something cold walks the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost. The Rimeheart. It makes the snow too cold even for giants.
Break it. Take a piece to Halvek, so he knows. Then come back.
Will you break the Rimeheart?
L15.started: Do not go alone. Even giants do not go alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: A giant of the plateau broke the Rimeheart? Good blood. Tell Borrik the Eyrie owes the camp a feast.

back.says: Halvek's word came on the coach. A feast! You are a real giant now. Learn this.

L20.name: Standing with Halvek
offer: Hmm. Borrik says you are grown. A grown giant stands with its kin once. Halvek is our kin. He keeps the outpost at the Goldfeather Eyrie.
Go. Stand with him. Do what he asks. Then come home, and choose your road.
Will you stand with Halvek?

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Hrolmog sends a giant! Good. The Goldfeather raiders mock my sentries from their eyrie. Bring me three of their war-talons.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Warden Halvek.
handin.says: Three talons! They will not mock us now. Go home, kin. Tell Hrolmog you stood well.

final.journal: Return to Elder Hrolmog in the giants' camp.
final.says: Halvek's word came first. You stood well. You are not small now. The camp has one more thing for you.
